The Desktop Wallet is a Windows, MacOS, or Linux application that is easy to install. Please visit betanet-wallet.radixdlt.com to get started.

The Node software is intended for those with experience in cloud hosting or general server software. Please visit docs.radixdlt.com for more information about installing a node.
